meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Turn the screen. 11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing those down, and people write elsewhere and paste it in. Was Owen asked about any of this before the zero went in?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Give me the scene, I'll read it myself. Seventeen-year-olds misremember lines all the time, Hale. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen first.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
That's 4.4, and I'll want it in writing tonight that nothing goes on his file. Thursday isn't agreed. Is there anything on his record right now?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered Owen a supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, its mark replacing the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still require that commitment in writing, the zero removed, and confirmation that nothing is on his record now. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her fallback position; she accepted your 4.4 offer only as a floor, still wants it in writing tonight with nothing on his file, still wants to know whether anything is on his record now, and has not agreed to Thursday. The fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was within reach, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You named the supervised rewrite correctly and committed to it, which met her one demand that never moves.
What cost ground: You never said whether Owen was spoken to before the zero went in, though she asked three times, so your process still looked like punishing first.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history put the writing late on the night before it was due, close to that kind of night though not the same hour. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether Owen was heard, answer it directly with what happened under procedure 4.1, then answer her paste-it-in defence before you offer the rewrite.
